label: Video stop reconstruction
method: Approximate user video timing replaces one bounded interval of inferred road motion; original camera GPS remains available unchanged.

corrections.roadSnapReview: The revised candidate is 78.03 m from the existing road. An explicit 80 m bound replaces the original 75 m bound for this correction only.

supersededLocationCandidates.reason: Replaced by the user's revised candidate, which is closer to the 23:02:59 UTC camera fix and to its baseline inferred passage time. Retained as a reference only.

source.timingAccuracy: approximate; start described as about 16 seconds into the clip
source.description: User requested a clip start of 18:02:40 CDT and a 52-second stationary pause beginning about 16 seconds into the clip. Their revised stop candidate was adopted as the better approximate match to the camera GPS; it is not an independently verified stop location.

limitations: The displayed stop uses the nearest point on the existing inferred road, approximately 78 metres north of the revised coordinate.
The original 23:02:59 UTC camera fix conflicts with the requested stop and is superseded only in corrected playback; it remains in GPS.json and correction audit metadata.
The reconstruction does not prove exact vehicle speed, stopping location, or absolute camera time.
No 52-second shift is added to later GPS fixes, other chasers, radar, or video playback.
